stem: Two plants share a commercial cultivar name and match at one sex-linked marker. Which conclusion is scientifically strongest?
choices: They are the same breeding line because the commercial name matches
The evidence is insufficient for whole-genome identity; pedigree, retained references, broader molecular data and phenotype records should be considered
They can be treated as identical if their flowers look similar
rationale: Names and single markers answer limited identity questions. Strong germplasm identity uses cumulative pedigree, reference, phenotype and appropriately broad molecular evidence.
